options.name: check_id
options.description: Required when C(state=absent). The Uptime check UUID to delete.

options.name: client_override_options
options.description: Client override options (developer use). For example, can be used to override the DigitalOcean API endpoint for an internal test suite. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Required when C(state=present). A boolean value indicating whether the check is enabled/disabled.

options.name: module_override_options
options.description: Module override options (developer use). Can be used to override module options to support experimental or future options. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: name
options.description: Required when C(state=present). A human-friendly display name.

options.name: regions
options.description: Required when C(state=present). An array containing the selected regions to perform healthchecks from.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the resource, C(present) to create, C(absent) to destroy.

options.name: target
options.description: Required when C(state=present). The endpoint to perform healthchecks on.

options.name: token
options.description: DigitalOcean API token. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value. C(DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN), C(DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN), C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN)

options.name: type
options.description: Required when C(state=present). The type of health check to perform.

options.name: unique_name
options.description: When C(true) for C(state=present) the Uptime check will only be created if it is uniquely named. When C(true) for C(state=absent) the Uptime check will only be deleted if it is uniquely named.
